items.html: When the second king reigned, which is Hesed, he drew the five Hassadim to expand in the Guf of Abba. When he died, he descended to Beria, and the five lights descended in Gevura in the third king. At that time, the posterior of Abba, made by the expansion of the above five Hassadim, fell, and now all of them have fallen, and the Hassadim descended in the Yesod of Abba, Abba returned his posterior to the anterior of Bina, and this state is called back-to-face, as the anterior of Bina is now facing the posterior of Hochma.
